description: Machine-readable MRRC-FT8 constraints distilled from SDD V1.0 and AGENTS.md.

rules.title: WSJT-X vendor tree is immutable
rules.message: Do not modify wsjtx-3.0.2/. Put required copies under dsp/patched/ and register the difference in SDD chapter 11 and AGENTS.md.

rules.title: ctypes DSP loading only in binding.py
rules.message: All shared-library loading and ABI calls belong in server/core/binding.py and execute only inside the DSP Worker.

rules.title: Decoder input is 12 kHz int16 mono
rules.message: No non-12 kHz rate may cross the decode ABI. TX 48 kHz belongs to waveform generation, not decode input.

rules.title: rigctld is the sole serial owner
rules.message: Application modules speak Hamlib TCP through server/engine/rig.py; they never open the CAT serial device.

rules.title: PTT is controlled only by rig and safety components
rules.message: No Web, DSP or sequencer module may key PTT directly. Route intent through the central safety controller.

rules.title: Authentication credentials never appear in URLs
rules.message: Use the Secure HttpOnly session cookie and validate Host/Origin; do not put auth tokens in REST or WebSocket URLs.

rules.title: No hardcoded secrets
rules.message: Passwords and secret keys come from protected configuration/bootstrap input and are stored as hashes, never source literals.

rules.title: No inline application logic in index.html
rules.message: index.html is a shell. Put vanilla JS behavior in modules under server/web/static/.

rules.title: Deployment device paths are configuration
rules.message: Audio/serial/device deployment values belong in configuration, not application source.

rules.title: Slot identity uses UTC epoch floor
rules.message: Use floor(epoch/TRperiod) for slot identity. Relative timers may wake tasks but may not define protocol phase; late actions are skipped.

rules.title: DSP Worker uses binding lock and batched results
rules.message: All DSP calls occur in the worker through binding.py's global lock. OpenMP threads aggregate in Fortran and never call Python.

rules.title: Waterfall may drop; safety state may not
rules.message: Keep waterfall on a separate bounded queue and drop old spectrum frames. Never let it block state, lease heartbeat or STOP TX.

rules.title: Behavior changes update the SDD
rules.message: Update affected SDD chapters and SDD/14-version-history.md with every behavior change; keep AGENTS.md and tests documentation current.
